policy: Offline: never downloads, never fetches upstream, never mutates a grammar or a registry. Reads validation/m14/grammar-pins.json (the pin contract) and validation/m60/grammar-survey.json (the upstream observation) and proves they agree with each other and with the prose sites that quote versions. It deliberately restates no pin, so it can never become a second version record.
